text:
Eva: quick flag — SI pilot hit a SCIM/KMS provisioning issue. Users are created but group syncs only include displayName; partner didn't send externalId. Also KMS key binding missing for service principals. Need triage.

Mohit: can you paste the partner SCIM sample payload so we can confirm which attributes are missing?

Eva: sample they sent:
```
{"schemas":["urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:core:2.0:User"],
 "userName":"alice@example.com",
 "name":{"givenName":"Alice","familyName":"Ng"},
 "groups":[{"display":"eng-team"}]
}
```
They only send display; no externalId or urn:enterprise:groupId.

Trent: that explains RBAC miss — our onboarding maps groups via externalId/urn:enterprise:groupId. Short-term: add onboarding fallback that canonicalizes displayName -> role. Long-term: request partner add group externalId in SCIM or use our SCIM extension.

Riley: I'll draft a one-pager and example PATCH to set the external KMS reference. Draft snippet:
```
PATCH /scim/v2/Users/1234
Content-Type: application/json
{
 "schemas":["urn:ietf:params:scim:api:messages:2.0:PatchOp"],
 "Operations":[{"op":"replace","path":"urn:redwood:ext:kms:externalKeyRef","value":"arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111:key/abcd-1234"}]
}
```

Mohit: add these rules to the doc: 1) key ARN must be in the customer's account (validate account id), 2) reject Redwood-managed key ARNs, 3) require signed partner auth header for control-plane SCIM edits, 4) HSM attestations are separate (ping if requested).

Trent: action items: 1) add displayName->role fallback in onboarding script (staging), 2) add schema validation that returns a clear 400 when kms externalKeyRef is missing with a link to devex guide. I'll open a PR today.

deploy-bot: Deployed branch platform/scim-display-fallback to staging at 2919999010 — run tests.

Trent: staging repro looks good: displayName "eng-team" maps to role=engineer via fallback. Requests missing urn:redwood:ext:kms:externalKeyRef now return 400 {"detail":"missing kms externalKeyRef; see devex guide"}.

Eva: I'll ask the SI to add externalId for groups and apply the PATCH for keys. Scheduling a 30m troubleshooting call Monday with partner engineers; will include legal/compliance for residency discussion.

Liz: For marketplace readiness checklist add: automated group provisioning (externalId/urn), kms externalKeyRef support, and published SCIM schema/docs. Keep pilot ask minimal.

Riley: uploaded draft devex doc: https://redwood.internal.devex/scim-kms-onboarding and a Postman collection to the repo. Will update after PR merges.

Mohit: if partner requests HSM attestation or key wrapping specifics, tag me — we have the internal checklist and required headers.

Eva: thanks all. I'll close once partner confirms retest. :white_check_mark:
